WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(eventannotm, 'MISSING') AS timing_group,
    AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS baseline_value
  FROM group_stats
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT
    gs.group_avg,
    gs.group_avg - b.baseline_value AS excess
  FROM group_stats gs, baseline b
  WHERE gs.group_avg > b.baseline_value
)
SELECT
  AVG(group_avg) AS mean_of_averages,
  AVG(excess) AS mean_excess
FROM above_baseline;
